overall_summary: Data shows clear engagement spikes on husband-wife relationship dynamics (wife/shaadi topics reaching ~1.7k views), significantly outperforming family and generic sad shayari themes. However, sample size is low, so confidence is moderate.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,761 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,666 views) received nearly 10x the views of other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on married life nuances, communication gaps, and post-marriage love evolution.

weak_patterns.pattern: Pure Sad Shayari / Heavy Text Quotes
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 6 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly poetic heavy sad shayari; anchor text to concrete real-life situations.
